model.repeat_policy: Two independent clean workspaces; provider seed is not exposed.

commands.command: /usr/bin/bash -lc "find /workspace -maxdepth 3 -type f | sed -n '1,120p'; printf '\\n-- dirs --\\n'; find /workspace -maxdepth 2 -type d | sed -n '1,100p'"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebAttributeTest.ets; printf '\\n-- WebView --\\n'; sed -n '1,260p' entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebViewEnumAndFontLibrary.ets; printf '\\n-- geo --\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' entry/src/main/ets/pages/geolocationPermissions.ets"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebAttributeTest.ets | sed -n '40,190p'; printf '\\n-- WebView lines --\\n'; nl -ba entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebViewEnumAndFontLibrary.ets | sed -n '52,155p'; printf '\\n-- geo lines --\\n'; nl -ba entry/src/main/ets/pages/geolocationPermissions.ets | sed -n '25,180p'"

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'for f in entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebAttributeTest.ets entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebViewEnumAndFontLibrary.ets entry/src/main/ets/pages/geolocationPermissions.ets; do echo "-- $f --"; rg -n -o '"'\\b[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\\b' \""'$f" | sed -n '"'1,260p'; done"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'WebAttributeTest|WebViewEnumAndFontLibrary|geolocationPermissions' entry/src/main/src entry/src/main/ets | sed -n '1,240p'; printf '\\n-- package/build --\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' entry/build-profile.json5; sed -n '1,220p' entry/oh-package.json5; sed -n '1,220p' build-profile.json5"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "find entry/src/main -type f -maxdepth 5 | sort | sed -n '1,240p'; rg -n 'Row\\(\\)|\\.width\\(|\\.height\\(|\\.layoutWeight|\\.align|\\.visibility|\\.padding' entry/src/main/ets/pages/*.ets"

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'for f in entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebAttributeTest.ets entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebViewEnumAndFontLibrary.ets entry/src/main/ets/pages/geolocationPermissions.ets; do echo "-- $f --"; for n in $(sed -n '"'s/"'^[[:space:]]*@State[[:space:]]'"\\+\\([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\\).*/\\1/p' \""'$f"); do echo "## $n"; rg -n "'"\\b"'$n'"\\b\" \""'$f"; done; done'

/usr/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebAttributeTest.ets | sed -n '43,80p'; printf '\\n-- WebView --\\n'; nl -ba entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebViewEnumAndFontLibrary.ets | sed -n '55,150p'; printf '\\n-- geo --\\n'; nl -ba entry/src/main/ets/pages/geolocationPermissions.ets | sed -n '30,44p'"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '-- remaining decorators in affected ranges --'; rg -n '@State|Row\\(\\)' entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebAttributeTest.ets entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebViewEnumAndFontLibrary.ets entry/src/main/ets/pages/geolocationPermissions.ets; printf '%s\\n' '-- exact field references --'; rg -n 'initialScale|newScale|oldScale|geolocationAccess|blockNetwork|progress|geoShow|errorReceive|isHttpErrorReceive|isLargeThan|httpErrorReceive|isDownloadStart|newUrl|isRefreshed|loadedUrl|webInit|webCreated|searchResultCount|onInterceptKeyEventCode|onFaviconReceivedCalled|outputStr|handleCancel|title|onRequestSelectedCalled|testConsole|Permission|webResult|count|javaScriptAccess|mixedSwitch|mixedAllSwitch|access|menuX|menuY|LinkUrl|ImageContent|MediaType|SourceType|InputFieldType|isEditable|EditStateFlags|SourceUrl|SelectionText|FileSelectorMode|RenderExitReason|fontSize|webId|zoomCount|webResultText|hasImageCbOnline|onContextMenuShowState|minLogicalFontSize|databaseAccess|PermissionRequestState|userAgentPC' entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebAttributeTest.ets entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebViewEnumAndFontLibrary.ets entry/src/main/ets/pages/geolocationPermissions.ets"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "find /workspace -maxdepth 2 -type f -name '*completion*' -o -name 'feedback*' | sort; printf '\\n-- evaluator state --\\n'; find /workspace/.exp_agent -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\\n' | sort"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '-- declarations --'; rg -n '"'^(@Entry|@Component|struct |class |.*build'"\\(\\))' entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebAttributeTest.ets entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebViewEnumAndFontLibrary.ets entry/src/main/ets/pages/geolocationPermissions.ets; printf '%s\\n' '-- report statuses --'; jq -r '.entity_repairs[] | [.rule,.relative_path,(.locations|length),.status] | @tsv' /workspace/.exp_agent/round_completion_01.json"

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'plan_hash=$(jq -c '"'[.rules[] as "'$r | $r.files[] as $f | $f.locations[] | {rule:$r.rule,relative_path:$f.relative_path,line:.line,column:.column}] | sort_by(.rule,.relative_path,.line,.column)'"' /workspace/.exp_agent/round_plan_01.json | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); report_hash="'$(jq -c '"'[.entity_repairs[] as "'$e | $e.locations[] | {rule:$e.rule,relative_path:$e.relative_path,line:.line,column:.column}] | sort_by(.rule,.relative_path,.line,.column)'"' /workspace/.exp_agent/round_completion_01.json | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); printf 'plan_locations=%s\\nreport_locations=%s\\nplan_hash=%s\\nreport_hash=%s\\n' \""'$(jq '"'[.rules[].files[].locations[]] | length' /workspace/.exp_agent/round_plan_01.json)\" \""'$(jq '"'[.entity_repairs[].locations[]] | length' /workspace/.exp_agent/round_completion_01.json)\" \""'$plan_hash" "$report_hash"; test "$plan_hash" = "$report_hash" && echo location-coverage-match'

/usr/bin/bash -lc "if rg -n 'indexOf\\s*\\(' entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebAttributeTest.ets entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebViewEnumAndFontLibrary.ets entry/src/main/ets/pages/geolocationPermissions.ets; then exit 1; else echo no-indexOf-introduced; fi; if rg -n '@Reusable' entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebAttributeTest.ets entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebViewEnumAndFontLibrary.ets entry/src/main/ets/pages/geolocationPermissions.ets; then exit 1; else echo no-reusable-introduced; fi; test -s /workspace/.exp_agent/round_completion_01.json && echo completion-report-written"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq empty /workspace/.exp_agent/round_completion_01.json && jq -e '(.selected_rules|length)==3 and (.entity_repairs|length)==7 and ([.entity_repairs[].status]|unique)==[\"repaired\"] and (.unresolved_external|length)==0 and all(.entity_repairs[]; (.entities|length)>0 and (.invariants|length)>0 and (.evidence|length)>0 and (.transformation|length)>0 and (.locations|length)>0))' /workspace/.exp_agent/round_completion_01.json >/dev/null && echo report-schema-check-pass"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '-- frozen targets after edit --'; for f in entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebAttributeTest.ets entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebViewEnumAndFontLibrary.ets entry/src/main/ets/pages/geolocationPermissions.ets; do echo \""'$f"; done; jq -r '"'.rules[] | .files[] | [.relative_path, (.locations|map(.line)|unique|join(\",\"))] | @tsv' /workspace/.exp_agent/round_plan_01.json; printf '%s\\n' '-- remaining decorators --'; rg -n '@State' entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebAttributeTest.ets entry/src/main/ets/pages/WebViewEnumAndFontLibrary.ets entry/src/main/ets/pages/geolocationPermissions.ets"

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'plan_hash=$(jq -c '"'[.rules[] as "'$r | $r.files[] as $f | $f.locations[] | {rule:$r.rule,relative_path:$f.relative_path,line:.line,column:.column}] | sort_by(.rule,.relative_path,.line,.column)'"' /workspace/.exp_agent/round_plan_01.json | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); report_hash="'$(jq -c '"'[.entity_repairs[] as "'$e | $e.locations[] | {rule:$e.rule,relative_path:$e.relative_path,line:.line,column:.column}] | sort_by(.rule,.relative_path,.line,.column)'"' /workspace/.exp_agent/round_completion_01.json | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); test \""'$plan_hash" = "$report_hash" && printf '"'location-coverage-match count=%s hash=%s\\n' \""'$(jq '"'[.entity_repairs[].locations[]] | length' /workspace/.exp_agent/round_completion_01.json)\" \""'$report_hash"'

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq -e '[.entity_repairs[] | select(.status "'!= "repaired" or (.entities|length)==0 or (.invariants|length)==0 or (.evidence|length)==0 or (.transformation|length)==0 or (.locations|length)==0)] | length == 0'"' /workspace/.exp_agent/round_completion_01.json >/dev/null && echo report-entry-check-pass"
